name: v1.16.0
body:
## What's Changed
* fix buttom bar do dot display token issue. by @laixintao in https://github.com/laixintao/iredis/pull/503
* update the set command with the latest version by @laixintao in https://github.com/laixintao/iredis/pull/504
* bugfix for GET command. by @laixintao in https://github.com/laixintao/iredis/pull/507
* add python 3.12, remove python 3.8 and python 3.9 by @laixintao in https://github.com/laixintao/iredis/pull/506
* Using iredis now triggers the following warning. I believe it's time to upgrade the Redis version to the latest release. by @ponponon in https://github.com/laixintao/iredis/pull/500
* relock the dependencies. by @laixintao in https://github.com/laixintao/iredis/pull/508
* fix more comamnds. by @laixintao in https://github.com/laixintao/iredis/pull/509
* add more commands from latest version of redis. by @laixintao in https://github.com/laixintao/iredis/pull/510

## New Contributors
* @ponponon made their first contribution in https://github.com/laixintao/iredis/pull/500

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/laixintao/iredis/compare/v1.15.2...v1.16.0
